sources.title: Block-diagonalization of infinite-volume lattice Hamiltonians with unbounded interactions

sources.supported_summary: The exact global direct rotation differs from perturbative local SW. The local transformed Hamiltonian retains corrections through the chosen order and a complete higher-order tail; linked-cluster structure controls local corrections.

sources.limits: Finite-dimensional and spin-system hypotheses do not supply the workbench's unbounded-domain proof, SU(2) source values or continuum construction.
